cohort: The study included 93,265 normotensive primiparous (37,387) and multiparous (55,878) participants from the Japan Environmental Children's Study database who delivered between 2011 and 2014, after excluding those with multiple gestations, preconception hypertension, and insufficient data.
finding: Excessive preconception carbohydrate intake increased the incidence of late-onset HDP in multiparous women, while low preconception carbohydrate intake increased the incidence of SGA births in both primiparous and multiparous women.
